scholarships.name: Ontario Professional Engineers Foundation for Education Scholarship
scholarships.eligibility: The Financial Aid and Students Awards Office will annually award two (2) level 1 students based on academic merit who are enrolled in any Bachelor of Engineering (Automation and Robotics) CEAB Accredited engineering programs. (**CEAB – Canadian Engineering Accreditation Board)

application.instructions: Apply through the bursary portal in ACSIS each term
